## Ability

Protect: other enemies within ~5 cells take 35% less damage (gold ring). The Warden is unprotected - shoot it first.

## How to spot its attack

A gold dashed ring on the ground: enemies inside take less damage. Its spear lands about half a second after it draws back. Shoot the Warden first.
